description: Claude Code plugins: a documentation pipeline, a prose-voice rulebook, an enforced council summarize-audit loop, and MCP server design patterns

plugins.name: kms-docs
plugins.description: DocSuite is a documentation pipeline: the writing-documentation rulebook plus a /write-doc command that orchestrates source grounding, drafting, bundled Playwright screenshot capture with a code-enforced data-leak guard, cross-model fact-check/edit/coverage review, and revision with two human gates

plugins.name: kms-human-voice
plugins.description: Writing style enforcement for prose a person reads: anti-AI phrase blacklist, em-dash limits, contrastive framing bans, hedging and throat-clearing, intensity modulation, structural prose tells, and an allowlist-gated intensity review

plugins.name: kms-mcp-patterns
plugins.description: Design patterns for building MCP servers

plugins.name: panel-audit
plugins.description: Two-stage fact-checking for multi-model councils on non-code work. run-panel dispatches seats in parallel, enforces a tooling gate (a seat that asserts facts must have research access), and returns seat reports on disk plus a claim ledger the seats produce themselves. The chair writes the deliverable, then verify-claims takes the ledger entries that survived into it and fans out tool-equipped verifiers in parallel, returning per-claim confirmed/wrong/imprecise/unverifiable/inherited with sources. An intermediate document is treated as a claim, not a source. Ships the working-with-panels skill, the run-panel and verify-claims workflows, the claim-verifier and panel-auditor agents, and an audit-summary hook backstop.
